    The Beholder's Gazette · Rules Quick Reference

    Nothing here matches. Try a shorter word.

    These are short summaries of rules from the System Reference Document 5.1 by Wizards of the Coast LLC, licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License. The wording is the Gazette's; when a summary and the SRD disagree, the SRD wins.
    Search filters the cards and highlights the matches, and the address bar keeps the search, so 🔗 Copy Link shares it. 🖨️ Print prints the cards on screen as a two-column cheat sheet. The conditions are the same list as the Toolbox's Initiative tracker.

    How to use the rules reference

    Seven sections on one page: the fifteen conditions, from blinded and charmed to stunned and unconscious; the six levels of exhaustion; cover; light, darkness, and vision; travel pace; typical difficulty classes; and what each lifestyle costs per day. Type in the search box and the cards narrow to the ones that match, with the words highlighted. The links above the cards jump to a section.

    At the table

    • Someone is grappled, knocked prone, or frightened. Search the condition and read two lines instead of hunting through an index.
    • The party wants to push on through the night. Check the travel pace for miles per day and the forced march rules for what it costs them.
    • A goblin ducks behind a low wall. Half cover or three-quarters? The cover card settles it before anyone starts arguing.
    • Print it before the session as a two-column cheat sheet and tape it inside your screen.

    Works with

    The same conditions appear in the Toolbox's Initiative tracker, and any section can go on your DM Screen as a card. For the spells and monsters the rules keep getting dragged into, see the Spellbook and the Bestiary.
